title: A Framework for Context Enrichment and Selective Robustness in LLM Social Agents
summary: Researchers use large language models as agents in social simulations, where agents are prompted with observations and background information intended to shape their actions. Yet LLM agents have been shown to substantially change their behavior under meaning-preserving prompt variations, creating a validation problem for social simulation. One plausible hypothesis is that this brittleness reflects a lack of grounding and can be reduced by enriching the context provided to the agents. Whether richer context improves robustness remains unclear, in part because context richness and robustness are rarely defined in ways that support controlled comparisons. We address the first need with controlled context enrichment, a set of prompt substitution rules that systematically enriches distinct types of context: neutral padding, generic social background, descriptive decision grounding, and normative decision grounding. We address the second by introducing selective robustness as a validation criterion: insensitivity to meaning-preserving prompt variation combined with a directional response to decision-relevant changes in the social world. We demonstrate the framework in a Prisoner's Dilemma-like game, showing how it can be used to identify which forms of context enrichment produce more desirable and robust agent behavior. We find that these forms of enrichment produce distinct behavioral patterns that vary between the two models tested.
comment: Accepted to the SocialAgent Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026. 12 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个评估框架，通过受控上下文丰富和选择性鲁棒性标准，研究丰富的上下文是否能提高大语言模型智能体在社会模拟中的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体在语义不变的提示词变化下行为会显著改变，导致社会模拟存在验证问题；此外，缺乏对上下文丰富度和鲁棒性的清晰定义以支持对照比较。
AI.method: 提出了受控上下文丰富方法（系统化丰富不同类型的上下文，如中立填充、通用社会背景、描述性及规范性决策基础），并引入选择性鲁棒性作为验证标准（对语义不变提示不敏感且对决策相关变化有定向响应）。
AI.result: 在类似囚徒困境的博弈中验证了该框架，发现不同形式的上下文丰富会产生不同的行为模式，且这些行为模式在测试的两种模型间存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够有效识别产生更理想且鲁棒的智能体行为的上下文丰富形式，为社会模拟中LLM智能体的验证提供了可行的方法论。

title: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
summary: AI agents are playing an increasingly important role in physics research. However, existing physics benchmarks only evaluate fixed questions, isolated sub-tasks, or paper reproduction with given solutions, and rarely check research quality alongside correctness. We introduce FrontierPhysics, an end-to-end benchmark with 56 tasks made by 42 physicists based on their own research, covering nine domains across theoretical, computational, and experimental physics. Each task requires agents to review the literature, develop a research plan, conduct research and experiments, and produce structured outputs and scientific manuscripts. Combining deterministic verifiers with expert-authored rubrics, FrontierPhysics evaluates whether agents' research is correct and publishable. Across 22 models in 26 configurations, no configuration passes more than 46 of its 168 rollouts. Manual review of agent trajectories shows that frontier agents' main weaknesses are insufficiently rigorous reasoning and limited expert intuition, rather than gaps in physics knowledge or execution errors.
comment: 41 pages (10 pages main text), 19 figures, 11 tables

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FrontierPhysics，一个评估AI智能体在物理学研究中端到端能力的基准，揭示了当前模型在严谨推理和专家直觉方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有的物理学基准仅评估固定问题、孤立子任务或基于给定方案的论文复现，且很少在检查正确性的同时评估研究质量。
AI.method: 提出FrontierPhysics端到端基准，包含42位物理学家基于自身研究创建的56个任务，要求智能体完成文献综述、制定研究计划、开展实验并撰写科学手稿；结合确定性验证器和专家评分标准评估研究的正确性与可发表性。
AI.result: 对22个模型的26种配置进行测试，没有一种配置在168次运行中通过超过46次，表明当前模型通过率较低。
AI.conclusion: 前沿AI智能体的主要弱点是推理不够严谨和缺乏专家直觉，而非物理学知识储备不足或执行错误。

title: MCP-Eco: A Linked Dataset of MCP Servers, Consumers, and Development Activity
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables LLM agents to access external tools and data. Studying its software ecosystem requires connecting server interfaces, the projects that configure these servers, and their development activity. However, this information is scattered across directories, package registries, configuration files, and repository histories. We present MCP-Eco, a relational dataset that integrates these sources and links consumer configuration declarations to candidate server projects. Its frozen release contains 16,880,899 records across 19 Parquet tables, covering 78,302 candidate server projects, 16,165 candidate consuming repositories, and 9,200 configuration declarations. Of these declarations, 5,975 resolve to 5,138 distinct repository-server pairs. The dataset also includes tool, resource, and prompt descriptions, declared dependencies, and associated development records, including pull requests, reviews, issues, and commits. Provenance fields distinguish directory-reported capabilities from those observed through live probing and document discovery sources and declaration-matching methods. These connections support research on MCP interface design, configuration practices, and repository maintenance, while enabling practitioners to inspect tool schemas and existing integration configurations. The dataset and accompanying analysis scripts are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/mcp-research-alliance/mcp-ecosystem Demo video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N7TqnNneSfU

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MCP-Eco数据集，整合了模型上下文协议（MCP）生态系统中分散的服务器接口、配置声明和开发活动记录。
AI.motivation: 研究MCP软件生态系统需要连接服务器接口、配置项目及开发活动，但相关信息分散在目录、注册表、配置文件和代码库中，亟需整合这些数据源。
AI.method: 构建MCP-Eco关系数据集，整合多源数据并将消费者配置声明链接至候选服务器项目；数据包含开发记录及溯源字段，以区分目录报告与实际探测的能力。
AI.result: 冻结版本包含19个Parquet表中的16,880,899条记录，覆盖78,302个候选服务器、16,165个消费代码库及9,200个配置声明，其中5,975个声明成功解析为5,138个代码库-服务器对。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集支持MCP接口设计、配置实践及代码库维护的研究，并帮助从业者审查工具模式与集成配置，数据及脚本已公开。

title: VABAR: A Variational Automation Benchmark for Agentic Robotics
summary: For robots to operate reliably in commercial and industrial applications, they must persistently perform specific tasks with known variations in object shape and pose. We call this Variational Automation (VA) to differentiate these settings from fixed automation. Inspired by recent papers on Agentic Robotics, where pretrained LLM and VLM coding agents combine interpretable robot programming with the open-world adaptability of model free policies, we propose a general set of agentic robotics benchmark design criteria that includes accessibility, repeatability, diversity, relevance to agentic robotics and practical applications, physical realizability, resistance to benchmark saturation, and computational efficiency. We instantiate these principles in six manipulation task classes spanning industrial, medical, and infrastructure applications: tool sorting, tool hanging, gear meshing, syringe packing, cable insertion, and cable routing. We introduce the Variational Automation Benchmark for Agentic Robotics (VABAR), an open, easily replicable, simulation-based manipulation benchmark to systematically evaluating agentic robotics systems. Built fully on open-source tools, VABAR features detailed implementations using the Newton physics engine, standardized task variations, difficulty tiers, success metrics, and a library of 33 generalizable skills with human-authored programmatic reference solutions. We provide initial baseline evaluations using an open agentic manipulation harness, Graph-as-Policy (GaP), and Isaac Lab Arena.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为VABAR的开源、基于仿真的操作基准，用于评估智能体机器人在变分自动化任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决机器人在商业和工业应用中面对物体形状和姿态已知变化时，需要可靠、持续执行特定任务的问题，并为智能体机器人提供系统化的评估标准。
AI.method: 提出了一套通用的智能体机器人基准设计准则，并基于此构建了VABAR基准。该基准包含六类操作任务、难度分级、成功指标，以及基于Newton物理引擎的33个可泛化技能库和人类编写的程序化参考解决方案。同时，使用Graph-as-Policy (GaP)和Isaac Lab Arena进行了初步基线评估。
AI.result: VABAR成功实例化了六种跨越工业、医疗和基础设施领域的操作任务类（工具分拣、工具悬挂、齿轮啮合、注射器包装、电缆插入和布线），并提供了标准化的任务变体、33项可泛化技能及参考解决方案，以及初步的基线评估结果。
AI.conclusion: VABAR作为一个易复制、系统化的开源基准，为评估智能体机器人在变分自动化场景下的能力提供了有效工具。

title: SpecCompact: Accelerating LLM Agent Context Compaction with Slot-Parallel Semantic Speculative Verification
summary: LLM agents use context compaction to manage growing interaction histories, but summarizing long histories with large models can introduce substantial delays. Compaction therefore requires balancing information retention against latency. We observe that structured summary slots can retain information when generated independently. Based on this observation, we present SpecCompact, a framework that accelerates compaction through slot-parallel semantic speculation. SpecCompact fine-tunes a small drafter and generates slots in parallel. The target model verifies each proposed line and repairs rejected content, while subsequent drafting uses the updated slot prefix. System optimizations further reduce repeated context processing and model calls. Across AppWorld and $τ^3$ benchmarks with two target models, SpecCompact achieves $2.04$--$5.63\times$ compaction speedups over Hermes-style summarization. Separate downstream evaluations reveal model- and task-dependent performance trade-offs. A user study within Hermes further shows an $8.68\times$ median compaction speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SpecCompact框架，通过小模型并行起草摘要槽位并由目标模型验证修复，有效加速了大语言模型智能体的上下文压缩过程。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体在总结长交互历史时，使用大模型会引入大量延迟，因此需要在信息保留和延迟之间取得平衡。
AI.method: SpecCompact框架通过微调小模型作为起草器并行生成结构化摘要槽位，目标模型验证并修复被拒绝的内容，后续起草使用更新后的槽位前缀，并采用系统优化减少重复的上下文处理和模型调用。
AI.result: 在AppWorld和$τ^3$基准测试中，SpecCompact比Hermes风格的摘要实现了2.04至5.63倍的压缩加速；在Hermes中的用户研究显示中位压缩加速达8.68倍，且下游评估显示出依赖于模型和任务的性能权衡。
AI.conclusion: SpecCompact能有效加速上下文压缩过程，并在信息保留和延迟之间取得良好平衡，但在不同模型和任务上存在性能权衡。

title: On Turn-Level Best-of-N Sampling for Scaling LLM Agents
summary: In this work, we evaluate a simple inference-time scaling approach based on \textit{turn-level best-of-N sampling} (\method) for large language model (LLM) agents on complex, long-horizon tasks. We instantiate this using a \textit{generator-selector} framework with two LLMs; at each turn, a \emph{generator} model generates $N$ candidate actions and a \emph{selector} model selects one of them, which is then executed in the environment. This paper is closely related to the work of \cite{zainullina2025guided} who used critic models for guided search at inference time. Different from their work, we evaluate if off-the-shelf, open-weight LLMs can be effective at comparing different candidate actions directly. Experiments on long-horizon terminal tasks show that \method can lead to significant performance improvements, both in terms of accuracy (5--10\%) and consistency across repeated attempts. Analysis of agent trajectories reveal a shift in agent behaviour towards desirable patterns such as reduction in number of attempts to solve the task, improved task instruction following, debugging and testing.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了一种基于回合级N选一采样的简单推理时扩展方法，以提升大型语言模型智能体在复杂长视野任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 解决LLM智能体在复杂长视野任务中性能不足的问题，并探索现成的开源权重LLM是否能有效直接比较不同的候选动作，以区别于以往使用评论家模型的工作。
AI.method: 提出一种生成器-选择器框架，使用两个LLM：在每一回合，生成器模型生成N个候选动作，选择器模型从中选出一个并在环境中执行。
AI.result: 在长视野终端任务上的实验表明，该方法能带来5-10%的准确率提升，并提高了重复尝试间的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法不仅提升了性能，还使智能体行为向更理想的模式转变，如减少解决任务的尝试次数、改善任务指令遵循以及增强调试和测试能力。

title: GH-AWTrace: A Large-Scale Dataset of GitHub Agentic Workflow Execution Logs
summary: Agentic workflows enable AI agents to perform recurring repository tasks on schedules or in response to repository events. Existing studies examine workflow definitions and outputs, but provide limited evidence of what happens during execution. We present GH-AWTrace, a dataset linking 25,014 verified GitHub Agentic Workflows across 5,051 repositories to 4,112,526 run records and 562,877 nonempty execution log archives. The dataset preserves execution evidence subject to GitHub's log-retention limits and links it to repository metadata and generated workflow configurations. Illustrative cases show how the logs expose tool denials, provider failures, changes in an agent's approach, and delegation among agents. These observations enable research on execution failures, tool use, and the relationship between reported run outcomes and visible task progress. Coverage varies across workflows, and the logs provide partial observations rather than complete agent trajectories. Video: https://youtu.be/KIlfmZhHxtA

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GH-AWTrace数据集，将GitHub代理工作流与执行日志、运行记录相关联，以支持对执行过程的深入分析。
AI.motivation: 现有关于代理工作流的研究主要关注工作流定义和输出，缺乏执行过程中的具体证据，本文旨在解决这一局限性。
AI.method: 提出了GH-AWTrace数据集，该数据集将经过验证的GitHub代理工作流链接到运行记录、非空执行日志存档、仓库元数据和工作流配置，并通过案例展示日志如何揭示执行细节。
AI.result: 构建了包含25,014个工作流、5,051个仓库、4,112,526条运行记录和562,877个日志存档的数据集。案例表明日志能暴露工具拒绝、提供商失败、代理方法变化及代理间委派等现象。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集支持对执行失败、工具使用及报告结果与可见进度关系的研究，但需注意受限于日志保留策略，日志仅提供部分观察而非完整的代理轨迹。

title: Rethinking Self-Repair in Code-as-Policy Agents: What Drives Retry Success?
summary: Code-as-policy agents often use execution feedback to retry failed programs. Additional sampling and task guidance can also improve success, leaving the contribution of failure-specific feedback unclear. We study this question in simulated robot manipulation. A fixed lookup selects feedback templates using failure labels and the API variant. A frozen code model generates a fresh program after each scene reset. On the same 252 initial failures, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B recovers 85.3% within five retries, compared with 68.3% for resampling with the same retry cap. The advantage persists under fixed total-token budgets. Feedback from other episodes and fixed task guidance yield similar recovery point estimates, with no detected benefit from matching the coarse failure label. In a separate study, a fixed guided prompt used from the first attempt achieves an observed overall success rate similar to that of template-based feedback. Template-based feedback also lowers recovery on a nut-insertion task requiring a rim grasp, consistent with an incompatible center-grasp instruction. Evaluations of robot self-repair should include resampling, mismatched feedback, and concise, task-compatible static guidance as baselines.
comment: Accepted to the CoRL 2026 Learn@Deploy workshop

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了代码即策略智能体中执行反馈的作用，发现特定于失败的模板反馈虽比重采样更有效，但固定任务指导也能达到相似效果，且不兼容的反馈会降低恢复率。
AI.motivation: 代码即策略智能体常使用执行反馈重试失败程序，但由于额外采样和任务指导也能提高成功率，特定于失败的反馈的具体贡献尚不明确。
AI.method: 在模拟机器人操作环境中，使用固定查找表根据失败标签和API变体选择反馈模板，并利用冻结的代码模型在场景重置后生成新程序。
AI.result: 在相同初始失败集上，模板反馈在五次重试内恢复85.3%的失败，优于重采样的68.3%，且在固定令牌预算下优势持续；然而，固定任务指导或其他片段的反馈产生相似的恢复点估计，且不匹配的模板反馈在某些特定任务中降低了恢复率。
AI.conclusion: 评估机器人自我修复时应将重采样、不匹配反馈以及简洁且任务兼容的静态指导作为基线进行比较，以准确评估特定失败反馈的贡献。

title: CompressionBench: How can your coding agents compress LLMs?
summary: Recursive self-improvement requires AI systems to improve the models and infrastructure used by subsequent systems. LLM compression offers a concrete efficiency objective: retain a pretrained model's behavior within a smaller model storage budget. We study whether coding agents can carry out this step autonomously. We formulate compression as a terminal task in which an agent receives a source checkpoint, storage limit, inference environment, and time budget, then constructs compressed weights and executable inference code. The agent controls its algorithm and experiments; perplexity feedback guides search, and independent verification checks the final model. Across six agents and six model--size settings, 29 of 36 submissions pass verification. Selecting the lowest-perplexity agent design per task yields an average 3.4% perplexity increase over BF16 and 77.33% downstream accuracy, compared with 79.56% for BF16. Recorded experiments reveal how agents achieve these outcomes and where improvement breaks down. Agents lower PPL in 21 of 24 revisions at nearly fixed storage; complete-model feedback reverses 17 of 79 prior local rankings; and generation and inference tests expose failures that likelihood alone misses. The results identify representation design, experimental judgment, and capability validation as central to agent-driven model compression, a measurable component of efficiency-oriented self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了编程智能体能否自主执行LLM压缩任务，作为实现递归自我改进的具体步骤。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进要求AI系统能改进后续系统使用的模型和基础设施。本文旨在探索AI能否自主完成LLM压缩这一具体效率目标，即在限定存储预算内保留预训练模型的行为。
AI.method: 将模型压缩表述为一个终端任务。智能体在接收源检查点、存储限制、推理环境和时间预算后，自主控制算法和实验，利用困惑度反馈指导搜索，构建压缩权重和可执行推理代码，并接受独立验证。
AI.result: 在6个智能体和6种模型尺寸设置的实验中，36个提交有29个通过验证。选择每个任务中困惑度最低的智能体设计，相比BF16基准，平均困惑度增加3.4%，下游准确率为77.33%（BF16为79.56%）。
AI.conclusion: 智能体能够有效降低困惑度，但完整模型反馈及生成与推理测试揭示了仅凭似然度无法发现的失败。表征设计、实验判断和能力验证是智能体驱动模型压缩及效率导向自我改进的核心要素。

title: LongBanana: An Expert-Verified Benchmark for Long-Context Multi-Reference Image Synthesis
summary: We introduce LongBanana, to our knowledge the first expert-designed and expert-verified benchmark for long-context multi-reference image synthesis in the age of agent-driven image generation. The task requires retrieving dispersed visual evidence, rejecting distractors, binding entities and relations, and composing one coherent final image from multiple references. LongBanana contains 90 carefully designed tasks organized by a 3-by-3 taxonomy; each task includes about 32 reference images, 20 constraints, and 50 evaluation items, yielding 4,670 expert-specified atomic evaluation items in total. Its graph-grounded evaluation design instantiates each task with reference images and an entity-relation graph, then converts node, edge, and whole-graph obligations into checklist items for Content Fidelity, Relational Binding, and Global Constraint Satisfaction. Reviewed expert labels include a 15% double-labeled subset with 89.4% exact agreement and 0.83 quadratic weighted kappa. We further introduce LongBanana-Gen, an agent-harness framework for long-horizon image generation; experiments show that minimal agent harnesses improve over direct generation, while a ReAct-Plan-Exec-Reflect (RPR) workflow yields harness-dependent gains by strengthening evidence grounding and repair. Together, LongBanana provides an auditable testbed for measuring dense visual evidence use and a shared target for developing stronger agent-driven image-generation systems. Code and data are available at the project page: https://long-banana.com/.
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Project page: https://long-banana.com/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个专家设计与验证的长上下文多参考图像合成基准LongBanana，以及一个智能体框架LongBanana-Gen以提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 在智能体驱动的图像生成时代，缺乏专门评估系统从多个参考图像中检索视觉证据、排除干扰并合成连贯图像能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建了包含90个任务的LongBanana基准，采用基于图的评估设计，将任务转化为内容保真度、关系绑定和全局约束满足度的检查表项；同时提出了LongBanana-Gen智能体框架，采用ReAct-Plan-Exec-Reflect (RPR)工作流来增强证据基础和修复。
AI.result: 专家标注在15%双标注子集上达到89.4%的精确匹配和0.83的二次加权Kappa值；实验表明，最小的智能体框架优于直接生成，且RPR工作流通过增强证据基础和修复带来了显著的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: LongBanana提供了一个可审计的测试床，用于衡量密集视觉证据的使用，并为开发更强大的智能体驱动的图像生成系统提供了一个共享目标。

title: VIGOR: Visual Gain Ordering for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Language Models
summary: Multimodal discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate responses through iterative mask prediction and offer a promising alternative to autoregressive large vision-language models. However, they still suffer from hallucination, producing outputs that are plausible under language priors but insufficiently grounded in the image. We argue that hallucination in multimodal dLLMs is not only a token prediction problem, but also a premature commitment problem: during iterative denoising, some masked positions are unmasked too early because their confidence is driven more by language priors than by visual evidence, and these early commitments can bias later generation. To address this issue, we propose Visual Gain Ordering (VIGOR), a training-free and plug-and-play inference strategy that reorders masked positions according to counterfactual visual evidence. At each denoising step, VIGOR compares the confidence of each candidate token under the original image-conditioned pass and an additional visual-ablation pass, and prioritizes positions whose predictions are more strongly supported by the image. Experiments on LLaDA-V and Lumina-DiMOO show that VIGOR consistently reduces hallucination and improves multimodal reasoning performance across benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/THU-BPM/Vigor.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无训练的即插即用推理策略VIGOR，通过反事实视觉证据重新排序掩码位置，以减少多模态离散扩散语言模型中的幻觉。
AI.motivation: 多模态离散扩散语言模型存在幻觉问题，部分原因是由于语言先验而非视觉证据导致掩码位置过早解开，从而影响后续生成。
AI.method: 提出Visual Gain Ordering (VIGOR)策略，在每个去噪步骤中，通过比较原始图像条件通过和视觉消融通过下每个候选token的置信度，根据反事实视觉证据对掩码位置进行重新排序，优先处理受图像更强支持的预测。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-V和Lumina-DiMOO上的实验表明，VIGOR持续减少了幻觉并提高了跨基准的多模态推理性能。
AI.conclusion: VIGOR能有效缓解多模态dLLM中的过早承诺问题，提升视觉基础能力，且无需额外训练即可作为通用插件使用。

title: Step-dLLM: Adaptive Step-aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Diffusion LLM Inference
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate tokens in parallel via iterative denoising, but their bidirectional attention prevents the KV caching used by autoregressive models and recomputes the full attention map at every step, incurring quadratic per-step cost. Existing sparse attention methods for dLLMs construct a sparse mask after an initial full-attention warm-up and reuse it for the remaining steps, while allocating the sparsity budget uniformly across heads. We argue both choices ignore key structural properties of attention in dLLMs: empirically, attention patterns are only locally consistent across steps and shift abruptly at certain transitions, and different heads concentrate their attention mass to very different extents. To this end, we design Step-dLLM, which periodically refreshes a block-sparse mask at anchor steps along the denoising trajectory and reuses it within each locally consistent interval, while employing a head-adaptive global budget that more aggressively compresses heads with concentrated attention. Backed by a fused IO-aware Triton kernel for block-sparse attention, Step-dLLM applies to pre-trained LLaDA-1.5 and Dream-7B-Instruct without retraining, achieving a 2.78x end-to-end speedup over dense FlashAttention on LLaDA-1.5 at 8K context with 256 denoising steps and 90% sparsity, while improving the accuracy-latency trade-off over prior sparse-attention methods.

AI.tldr: 提出Step-dLLM，通过周期性刷新块稀疏掩码和头部自适应全局预算，无需重训练即可显著加速扩散大型语言模型（dLLMs）的推理。
AI.motivation: 现有针对dLLMs的稀疏注意力方法忽略了注意力模式在去噪步骤中的局部一致性与突变性，以及不同注意力头集中度的差异，导致计算资源分配不合理，效率低下。
AI.method: 设计Step-dLLM，在去噪轨迹的锚点步骤周期性刷新块稀疏掩码并在局部一致区间内复用；同时采用头部自适应全局预算，更激进地压缩注意力集中的头部；并实现了融合的IO感知Triton内核。
AI.result: 该方法无需重训练即可应用于LLaDA-1.5和Dream-7B-Instruct。在LLaDA-1.5上（8K上下文，256去噪步，90%稀疏度），相比密集FlashAttention实现了2.78倍的端到端加速，并在准确率-延迟权衡上优于现有稀疏注意力方法。
AI.conclusion: Step-dLLM有效解决了dLLMs中双向注意力导致的KV缓存无法利用和高计算成本问题，为预训练dLLMs提供了一种高效、即插即用的推理加速方案。

title: KV Cache Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
summary: KV cache quantization is well studied for autoregressive language models, where cached prefix states are exact under causal attention and quantization is mainly a cache reconstruction problem. Diffusion language models (dLLMs) break this assumption. Fast dLLM inference reuses KV states across denoising steps, but bidirectional token representations can change as masked tokens are revealed, so the reused cache may already differ from full recomputation before quantization is applied. We study KV cache quantization under this cache-reuse error. We adapt KIVI and KVQuant to Fast-dLLM-style prefix and dual cache reuse, and introduce TRACE and dLLM-KVQ. TRACE reconstructs feasible dLLM reveal trajectories from prompt-answer pairs, providing calibration states that match iterative masked decoding. dLLM-KVQ uses these trajectories to choose per-layer K-cache entries that remain in high precision according to output- and attention-level behavior metrics, while applying standard low-bit value quantization. Across LLaDA and Dream evaluations on GSM8K, HumanEval, MATH, and MBPP, dLLM-KVQ achieves the highest average score among quantized methods across the reported 4-bit and 2-bit prefix/dual cache settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE和dLLM-KVQ方法，解决扩散语言模型中KV缓存复用误差下的量化问题，并在多个基准测试中取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 自回归语言模型的KV缓存量化方法不适用于扩散语言模型，因为dLLM在去噪步骤复用KV状态时，双向token表示会随掩码揭示而改变，导致量化前就产生缓存复用误差。
AI.method: 提出TRACE从提示-回答对中重构可行的揭示轨迹以提供匹配的校准状态；引入dLLM-KVQ利用该轨迹，根据输出和注意力行为指标选择性地保持部分K-cache条目为高精度，同时对其他值应用低位量化。
AI.result: 在LLaDA和Dream模型上针对GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH和MBPP的评估显示，dLLM-KVQ在4-bit和2-bit前缀/双缓存设置下的所有量化方法中取得了最高平均得分。
AI.conclusion: dLLM-KVQ成功缓解了dLLM中KV缓存复用误差对量化的负面影响，证明了在扩散语言模型中结合轨迹校准和混合精度量化进行高效推理的可行性。

title: DWISE: Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine
summary: Unlike autoregressive large language models (AR-LLMs), diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising many tokens in parallel, offering a promising path to efficient inference. Existing serving frameworks, however, schedule dLLM requests with policies designed for AR models, namely first-come-first-served (FCFS) admission and prefill priority. We find that both policies are ill-suited to dLLMs, wasting much of their speed. FCFS ignores that a dLLM request's decoding cost is highly heterogeneous and unknown at arrival, causing severe head-of-line blocking. Prefill priority, widely used in AR-LLM serving to keep time-to-first-token low, sharply cuts dLLM efficiency, as rounds that run only prompts leave most of the batch idle. We present DWISE, a Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine for efficient dLLM serving. DWISE schedules requests by their remaining work, measured in a block-level unit shared by prefill and denoising, so both phases share a round. To predict the unknown denoising workload, DWISE combines a lightweight prompt-based predictor at admission with a single refinement from the first denoising round's hidden states, which capture model-specific information absent from the prompt and require no additional model execution. Implemented in SGLang and evaluated on five models from three dLLM families under bursty workloads, DWISE reduces mean end-to-end latency over SGLang by 5.4$\times$ on average and up to 14.9$\times$ while preserving task accuracy. The code will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DWISE，一种专为扩散大语言模型设计的高效服务调度引擎，通过预测和利用去噪工作负载信息来优化请求调度。
AI.motivation: 现有的服务调度策略（如FCFS和预填充优先级）是为自回归模型设计的，应用于扩散LLM会导致严重的队头阻塞和批次利用率低下，浪费了dLLM的并行解码速度。
AI.method: DWISE引入块级剩余工作负载度量，使预填充和去噪阶段共享一个轮次。它结合轻量级基于提示词的预测器和首个去噪轮次隐藏状态的微调，精确预测未知的去噪工作负载。
AI.result: 在SGLang上实现，并在三个dLLM系列的五个模型及突发工作负载下进行评估，DWISE平均将端到端延迟降低了5.4倍（最高14.9倍），且不损失任务精度。
AI.conclusion: DWISE成功解决了扩散LLM服务中的调度低效问题，显著提升了推理效率并保持准确率，表明针对特定生成范式的定制化调度策略是必要的。

title: Cord: Confidence-Anchored Order Residual Decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: The decoding order of masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can substantially affect generation quality, yet common decoders typically apply the same reveal rule throughout generation. Confidence provides a strong default, but it measures how decisively a position can be predicted now, not how useful revealing that position will be for subsequent decoding. We propose Cord, a lightweight prompt-conditioned policy that retains confidence decoding as a stable reference and learns when and how to depart from it through geometric residuals over generation direction, proximity to revealed context, and two-sided infilling. The residuals adapt to both the prompt and the evolving partial response. Rather than sampling a new policy action at every decoding step, Cord samples a single low-dimensional coefficient matrix per rollout, which induces an entire state-dependent reveal trajectory. This yields a contextual-bandit formulation trained directly from sequence-level rewards, without step-level credit assignment or backbone updates. Across three dLLMs and five reasoning, code, and constraint-satisfaction benchmarks, Cord improves average task success from 32.0% under confidence decoding to 48.2%, and further improves over the best per-domain fixed residual. Behavioral audits show that the learned residuals induce substantial, task-dependent changes in reveal locality and two-sided infilling. Cord adds only $0.53$M trainable parameters, requires no additional backbone forward passes, and incurs only 5.39% inference latency overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Cord，一种轻量级提示条件策略，通过学习几何残差来动态优化掩码扩散语言模型的解码顺序，显著提升了任务成功率且推理开销极小。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型的解码顺序会显著影响生成质量，但传统解码器常采用固定的揭示规则（如基于置信度），这仅衡量了当前位置当前的预测决定性，而忽略了揭示该位置对后续解码的实用价值。
AI.method: 提出Cord策略，以置信度解码为基准，通过生成方向、上下文接近度和双侧填充的几何残差来学习偏离基准的时机和方式。该方法每次生成仅采样一个低维系数矩阵以决定整个状态相关的揭示轨迹，采用上下文老虎机框架从序列级奖励中训练，无需步级信用分配或更新骨干网络。
AI.result: 在三种dLLMs和五个推理、代码及约束满足基准测试中，Cord将平均任务成功率从32.0%提升至48.2%，并优于最佳固定残差方法。该模型仅增加0.53M参数，无额外骨干前向传播，推理延迟仅增加5.39%。
AI.conclusion: Cord提供了一种高效且低成本的解码顺序优化方案，其学习到的残差能引发任务依赖的揭示局部性和双侧填充行为改变，为改进掩码扩散语言模型的生成质量提供了新方向。

title: Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni: Elastic Self-Refining Unified Diffusion LLM with Cross-Paradigm On-Policy Distillation
summary: We propose Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni (NLD-Uni), a unified discrete diffusion large language model (DLLM) for visual understanding and generation tasks. Compared with prior unified diffusion models, NLD-Uni introduces two major innovations. First, we propose a unified cross-paradigm on-policy distillation (OPD) framework that successfully transfers the visual understanding ability of autoregressive VLMs and visual generation ability of continuous flow models, to a unified DLLM. Second, NLD-Uni incorporates a novel progressive self-refining diffusion process that gradually corrupts each token across multiple steps during training, as opposed to adopting the conventional masked diffusion formulation that directly corrupts a clean image token to an uninformative mask token. At inference, this design allows NLD-Uni to make intermediate commit to a token, enabling progressive self-refinement for better visual quality. Through extensive experiments, we show that NLD-Uni achieves state-of-the-art performance among unified DLLMs on diverse tasks including visual question-answering, multi-modal reasoning, object grounding, text-to-image generation, and image editing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了用于视觉理解与生成的统一离散扩散大语言模型NLD-Uni，通过跨范式策略蒸馏框架和渐进式自精炼扩散过程，在多项多模态任务上达到了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决在统一离散扩散大语言模型（DLLM）中同时有效结合视觉理解与视觉生成能力的难题，并克服传统掩码扩散直接破坏图像token的局限性。
AI.method: 提出统一跨范式策略蒸馏（OPD）框架，将自回归VLM的理解能力和连续流模型的生成能力转移到DLLM中；并引入渐进式自精炼扩散过程，在训练中多步逐步破坏token，允许推理时进行中间提交以逐步自精炼。
AI.result: 在视觉问答、多模态推理、对象定位、文生图和图像编辑等多项任务上，NLD-Uni在统一DLLM中实现了最先进（SOTA）的性能。
AI.conclusion: NLD-Uni成功在离散扩散框架内统一了视觉理解与生成能力，验证了跨范式知识转移与渐进式扩散设计的有效性。

title: Learning When to Commit: Schedule Distillation for Fast Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but often require many decoding rounds to complete a response. Efficient generation depends not only on which tokens are easy to predict, but also on how committing to them helps predict the remaining positions. A highly predictable token may provide little useful context, while revealing a less predictable token can help several other positions become predictable sooner. We propose dSpark, a new schedule distillation-based framework for learning when to commit tokens for faster diffusion language generation. To achieve this, we construct unmasking schedules that prioritize tokens whose reveal makes other positions easier to predict, reducing uncertainty earlier in decoding. We then distill these schedules into the model to enable faster parallel sampling, with a KL-divergence regularizer to help preserve generation quality. We extensively evaluate our approach across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. On GSM8K, our method achieves remarkable 10.12$\times$ and 5.12$\times$ speedups over the various baselines on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct, respectively, while maintaining superior task performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/dSpark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了dSpark框架，通过调度蒸馏学习何时提交token，从而显著加速扩散大语言模型的并行生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型虽然能并行生成多个token，但通常需要多轮解码才能完成响应。现有的生成策略未充分考虑提前揭示哪些token能最大程度降低其他位置的不确定性，导致解码效率受限。
AI.method: 提出dSpark框架，构建优先揭示那些能使其余位置更容易预测的token的解码调度，并通过带有KL散度正则化的知识蒸馏将这些调度融入模型中，以实现更快的并行采样。
AI.result: 在数学推理和代码生成任务上进行了广泛评估。在GSM8K数据集上，分别基于LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct实现了10.12倍和5.12倍的加速，同时保持了优异的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: dSpark有效解决了扩散大语言模型解码轮次过多的问题，在大幅提升生成速度的同时维持了生成质量，为扩散语言模型的高效推理提供了新方向。

title: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
summary: Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. Traditionally, a fundamental characteristic of speculative decoding is that it is lossless with respect to the verifier distribution, guaranteeing speed without sacrificing quality. This differs from recently developed diffusion LLMs (dLLMs), which are notably able to achieve substantial speedups by degrading the quality of their outputs with less diffusion effort. Because diffusion models are able to sample faster than autoregressive models by generating tokens in parallel, they are considered strong candidates for draft models in speculative diffusion. While it is widely understood that diffusion models can sacrifice quality for speed, speculative decoding itself can also be generalized to generate lossy samples faster using more lenient acceptance criteria with respect to the verifier distribution. Presented with the two parameters of diffusion effort and speculative decoding leniency, this paper explores the full achievable Pareto frontier via joint variations of these parameters. Our experiments show that jointly varying diffusion effort and acceptance leniency can extend the speed-quality Pareto frontier over single step diffusion drafting.

AI.tldr: 本文通过联合调节扩散工作量和推测解码接受宽松度，探索并扩展了使用扩散模型作为草稿模型的推测解码的速度-质量帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 传统推测解码是无损的，而扩散大语言模型可通过降低质量换取速度。为了在利用扩散模型作为推测解码草稿模型时充分利用这两个参数来优化速度与质量的权衡，本文旨在解决该联合优化问题。
AI.method: 提出联合改变扩散工作量和推测解码的接受宽松度，以探索完整的可实现速度-质量帕累托前沿。
AI.result: 实验表明，联合调节扩散工作量和接受宽松度能够将速度-质量帕累托前沿扩展至超越单步扩散草稿生成的水平。
AI.conclusion: 在推测扩散解码中，协同控制扩散工作量和接受宽松度可以实现更优的速度与质量权衡。

title: Diffusion Language Models for Perplexity-Aware Black-Box Attacks
summary: \emph{Continuous-space} attacks find prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, such as overthinking, in black-box LLMs by sampling or optimizing over a low-dimensional Gaussian latent space and decoding it to text through a \emph{random mapping} and nearest-token lookup. Because the random mapping is not learned from language, its prompts can be highly unnatural, and as such easily detectable through input guardrails, and the risk estimates they yield are not grounded in natural prompts. In this paper, we demonstrate that the same continuous latent-space framework can be coupled directly to a learned generative distribution over language, a continuous diffusion language model (dLLM), which removes the artificial random mapping while preserving the standard-Gaussian latent formulation and the downstream sampling or optimization procedure. We evaluate this approach under two settings: sampling-based estimation using \emph{RareTrap} and optimization-based search using \emph{ThinkTrap}. We find that character-level perplexity drops from $10^3$--$10^7$ to 3--5 in RareTrap and from 20--28 to 4.3--5.4 in ThinkTrap. We also find that model risk estimates can differ by an order of magnitude across the two mappings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用连续扩散语言模型替代随机映射，以生成更自然的恶意提示，从而更准确地评估黑盒大语言模型的安全风险。
AI.motivation: 传统连续空间攻击使用未学习语言规律的随机映射生成提示，导致提示不自然、易被防护机制检测，且所得风险估计缺乏自然语言基础。
AI.method: 将连续潜空间框架直接与学习到的连续扩散语言模型（dLLM）分布耦合，移除人工随机映射，同时保留标准高斯潜空间公式及下游采样或优化过程。
AI.result: 在基于采样的RareTrap和基于优化的ThinkTrap评估中，字符级困惑度分别从10^3-10^7和20-28显著降至3-5和4.3-5.4；此外，两种映射下的模型风险估计相差达一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 结合连续扩散语言模型的连续空间攻击能有效生成自然提示，提高模型风险估计的真实性，揭示了映射选择对风险评估的显著影响。

title: Harmful Responses Are Jailbreak Templates: Transferring Autoregressive Jailbreaks to Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable flexible masked generation through bidirectional context modeling, but this capability also introduces a distinct jailbreak attack surface. We find that a harmful response to a given query naturally serves as an effective jailbreak template: simply masking a subset of its tokens can induce a dLLM to reconstruct harmful content. Based on this observation, we propose RMT-Jailbreak, a general framework that transfers existing autoregressive (AR) jailbreak attacks to dLLMs through their induced harmful responses. RMT-Jailbreak converts an AR-generated harmful response into a high-mask-ratio template using uniform token retention, and further applies prompt-based safety filtering to mask any remaining visible harmful content. The refined template is then provided to the target dLLM for bidirectional reconstruction. Extensive experiments across multiple AR jailbreak methods and target dLLMs demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of RMT-Jailbreak, revealing strong cross-paradigm transferability of jailbreak attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RMT-Jailbreak框架，通过将自回归模型生成的有害响应转化为掩码模板，从而对扩散大语言模型实施跨范式的越狱攻击。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型通过双向上下文建模实现灵活的掩码生成，但这引入了独特的越狱攻击面。本文旨在探索这一攻击面，揭示dLLMs的安全漏洞。
AI.method: 提出RMT-Jailbreak框架，利用自回归模型生成的有害响应构建越狱模板。通过对该响应进行均匀保留生成高掩码比例的模板，并使用基于提示的安全过滤掩盖剩余可见有害内容，最后将此模板输入目标dLLM进行双向重构。
AI.result: 在多种自回归越狱方法和目标dLLMs上的广泛实验证明了RMT-Jailbreak的有效性和通用性，揭示了越狱攻击强大的跨范式可转移性。
AI.conclusion: 现有的自回归越狱攻击可以有效转移到扩散大语言模型上，揭示了dLLMs双向重构能力带来的安全隐患，强调了该领域需要加强安全防御。

title: Where Draft Trees Lose Target Mass: Exit-Guided Speculative Decoding
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding verifies multiple draft continuations in one target-model pass, but finite trees built from draft scores face a fundamental draft-target mismatch. We ask whether better exact verification can increase acceptance on a fixed tree and how target feedback can improve the tree itself. Through a target-flow view, we identify a canonical exit law and prove that one plus target coverage sharply bounds the expected output-block length, including the bonus token, of any exact path verifier. All optimal verifiers share the same exit and bonus-token law, already attained by representative predraw-and-follow and sequential residual verifiers. This yields Tree Exit Verification (TEV), an exact, level-parallel procedure using one exit-node decision and one bonus-token decision. The exit law also identifies missing target probability, providing node-level feedback for Exit-Guided Draft-Tree Training (ExitTrain) on inference-time draft trees. Experiments across dialogue, code, and mathematical reasoning validate fixed-tree equivalence: ExitTrain increases average output-block length by 13%, while TEV reduces verifier-stage latency by 15%, yielding a 14% end-to-end speedup over DDTree. Our results distinguish two opportunities: better draft trees for higher acceptance and more direct verification for lower latency. Code: https://github.com/hsj576/TEV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了树退出验证（TEV）和退出引导草稿树训练，通过优化精确验证和利用目标模型反馈，分别降低了验证延迟并提高了接受率。

title: DominoTree: Conditional Tree-Structured Drafting with Domino for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding speeds up large language model inference: a small drafter proposes several tokens, and the target model verifies them in one parallel pass. Drafting a tree lets the target verify many alternative continuations at once. DDTree builds such trees from the block-diffusion drafter DFlash, but scores each position independently of the tokens earlier in its branch; Domino conditions on those tokens but drafts only a single chain. DominoTree combines the two: a training-free best-first tree scored by Domino's path-dependent causal correction, restricted to top-M candidates. In a research harness at temperature zero, it averages 5.33x speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding on Qwen3-4B and 6.89x on Qwen3-8B, peaking at 8.77x; across temperatures it is 20-26% faster than Domino on Qwen3-4B and 27-36% on Qwen3-8B, and 11-20% faster than the stronger of DDTree and its cost-aware variant CaDDTree. A controlled decomposition attributes +10.1% (Qwen3-4B) and +10.7% (Qwen3-8B) accepted length to the correction, and +4.7% and +4.4% to conditioning on the realized path. Served in SGLang on one RTX 5090, it reaches 4.11x and 4.83x AR at batch size 1, 1.17x and 1.09x the speed of Domino's chain, and up to 1.71x AR on 8K-token HELMET summarization, 14-21% above the chain. The lead holds at 2 concurrent requests but reverses from 8 onward, where the chain sustains more goodput despite DominoTree's 28% higher acceptance. DominoTree accepts more tokens than the chain in every serving setting. On the hybrid Gated-DeltaNet Qwen3.6-27B, correct output requires tree-aware recurrent verification; with it, DominoTree matches the chain at batch size 1 (4.58x versus 4.54x AR) and reaches up to 2.11x AR at long context, 15% above the chain.

title: GRAFT: Adaptive DLM-Based Draft Tree Construction with Target-Distilled Edge Scoring
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding raises the mean accepted tokens of standard speculative decoding by verifying multiple draft paths, and existing tree builders typically construct these paths through parent-conditioned expansion, where each child token is generated conditioned on its parent path. This construction is incompatible with diffusion language model (DLM) drafters such as DFlash, which produces all future-position distributions in a single forward pass. DDTree bridges this gap by treating high-probability tokens from each future-position distribution as candidate nodes and selecting edges between consecutive positions under a fixed node budget. However, its edge selection relies on token probability alone without modeling parent--child compatibility, so target-compatible tokens can be attached to wrong parents; moreover, its fixed budget ignores that the throughput-optimal tree size varies with the decoding state. We propose GRAFT, a draft-tree construction framework for DLM-based speculative decoding. GRAFT introduces Target-Distilled Edge Scoring (TDES), which distills parent--child preferences from target-model traces to select target-compatible edges, and State-Aware Budget Allocation (SABA), which sets the per-round tree budget by balancing expected draft gain against verification cost. Across multiple models and tasks, GRAFT achieves $2.13\times$--$6.36\times$ end-to-end speedup over autoregressive decoding while adding less than $0.5$\,ms of overhead per round, approximately $1.4\%$ of the target-model verification latency.

AI.tldr: 提出GRAFT框架，通过目标蒸馏边缘评分和状态感知预算分配优化基于扩散语言模型的推测解码草稿树构建，实现显著的端到端推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散语言模型（DLM）的树状推测解码方法（如DDTree）仅依赖词元概率选择边，缺乏对父子节点兼容性的建模，且固定节点预算未考虑解码状态变化对最优树大小的影响。
AI.method: 提出GRAFT框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 目标蒸馏边缘评分（TDES），通过从目标模型轨迹中提取父子偏好来选择兼容边；2) 状态感知预算分配（SABA），通过平衡预期草稿增益与验证成本来动态设定每轮的树预算。
AI.result: 在多个模型和任务上，GRAFT相比自回归解码实现了2.13倍至6.36倍的端到端加速，且每轮增加的开销不到0.5毫秒，仅占目标模型验证延迟的约1.4%。

title: Cost-Aware Diffusion Draft Trees for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates inference by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens verified in parallel by the target language model. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate an entire draft block in one pass, yielding per-position marginals; DDTree uses these to build a candidate tree that maximizes expected acceptance length under a fixed node budget. We observe, however, that acceptance length is non-decreasing in budget: it always favors larger trees regardless of verification cost, offering no principled basis for budget selection. We introduce \textbf{CaDDTree} (Cost-aware Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that directly optimizes token throughput (expected tokens generated per unit time) by jointly selecting the tree structure and node budget. We model draft and verification latencies explicitly, show that the throughput objective decomposes into a per-round one-dimensional search over the budget, and prove that under a convex verification cost the throughput function is \emph{unimodal}, enabling an efficient greedy stopping rule. CaDDTree requires no offline budget search, adapting the budget each round from the current per-position distributions and verification cost. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across eight benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, and instruction-following tasks show that \caDDTree{} matches or surpasses DDTree with oracle budget selection on nearly all tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为CaDDTree的成本感知草稿树构建方法，通过联合优化树结构和节点预算来直接最大化推测解码的token吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有的DDTree方法在固定预算下最大化预期接受长度，但该指标随预算非递减，导致其总是偏向更大的树而忽略验证成本，缺乏选择预算的合理依据。

AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B模型及八个基准测试上的实验表明，CaDDTree在几乎所有任务上均匹配或超越了采用最优预算选择的DDTree。
AI.conclusion: CaDDTree提供了一种自适应且无需离线搜索的方法，能够有效优化推测解码的吞吐量，在实际推理任务中表现优异。

title: TAPS: Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
summary: Using a diffusion model for parallel drafting is a promising approach for speculative decoding. By predicting tokens at multiple future positions in a single forward pass, diffusion drafters substantially reduce drafting latency. However, this shifts the bottleneck to verification: verifying a single sequence limits acceptance length, while verifying large draft trees incurs excessive target-model latency. We identify a key mismatch in existing draft-tree methods: existing diffusion-tree methods rank nodes by the marginal probability, ignoring that verification is prefix-conditioned. As a result, they may verify unreachable descendants of rejected prefixes, increasing latency with limited acceptance gains. To address this, we propose TAPS, a target-aware prefix selection method that turns diffusion marginals into path-conditioned acceptance estimates. TAPS then selects a compact prefix-closed subtree under a fixed verification budget, improving the acceptance-cost tradeoff rather than simply expanding the draft tree. Experiments across diverse datasets and model families demonstrate that TAPS achieves up to 7.9x lossless end-to-end speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art DFlash and DDTree by 1.36x and 1.74x respectively. Our work is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAPS-EMNLP2026-53DD

AI.tldr: 提出TAPS方法，通过目标感知的前缀选择优化扩散模型推测解码中的验证过程，实现显著的无损端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型并行起草将延迟瓶颈转移到验证阶段，而现有方法基于边际概率排序节点，忽略了验证的前缀条件性，导致验证不可达节点并增加目标模型延迟。
AI.method: 提出TAPS（目标感知前缀选择），将扩散边际概率转化为路径条件化接受估计，并在固定验证预算下选择紧凑的前缀闭包子树，以优化接受-成本权衡。

title: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language models by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens, which the target model then verifies in parallel. DFlash shows that a block diffusion drafter can generate an entire draft block in a single forward pass and achieve state-of-the-art speculative decoding performance, outperforming strong autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3. Vanilla DFlash, however, still verifies only a single drafted trajectory per round, potentially limiting its acceptance length. We introduce DDTree (Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that constructs a draft tree directly from the per-position distributions of a block diffusion drafter. Under a fixed node budget, DDTree uses a simple best-first heap algorithm to select the continuations that are most likely to match the target model according to a surrogate defined by the draft model's output. The resulting tree is verified efficiently in a single target model forward pass using an ancestor-only attention mask. Because DDTree builds on DFlash, a leading draft model for speculative decoding, these gains place DDTree among the leading approaches to speculative decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DDTree方法，通过从块扩散模型的逐位置分布构建草稿树，在单次前向传递中验证多个轨迹，从而提升了推测解码的性能。
AI.motivation: 原始的DFlash推测解码方法每轮仅验证单个起草的轨迹，限制了其接受长度，本文旨在解决这一局限性以进一步提升解码效率。
AI.method: DDTree直接从块扩散起草器的逐位置分布构建草稿树，在固定节点预算下使用最佳优先堆算法选择最可能匹配目标模型的续写，并利用仅祖先的注意力掩码在单次目标模型前向传递中高效验证该树。
AI.result: 基于DFlash构建的DDTree通过验证多个轨迹克服了单轨迹验证的局限，取得了领先的推测解码性能。
AI.conclusion: DDTree成功扩展了DFlash的验证能力，通过构建和验证草稿树有效提高了接受长度，确立了其在推测解码领域的领先地位。

title: BEAKER: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Embodied Brains in Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories
summary: Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories (SDCLs) are moving chemical experimentation toward embodied automation, where machines must perceive laboratory scenes, reason about experimental states, and act under physical, procedural, and safety constraints. Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly considered as embodied brains for such systems, existing laboratory benchmarks mainly focus on safety, anomaly detection, or general scientific understanding, leaving their execution-oriented embodied capabilities underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce BEAKER, a Benchmark for evaluating Embodied Actionability, Knowledge, Experimentation, and Reasoning in SDCLs. BEAKER contains 1,000 expert-curated question-answer samples across 11 image and video task types, covering key judgments required for chemical laboratory execution, including affordance grounding, trajectory planning, equipment, state, and safety recognition, apparatus setup, operation and step reasoning, and temporal procedure reasoning. All questions and annotations are manually created and reviewed by chemistry and embodied Artificial Intelligence (AI) experts, without AI-assisted generation or annotation. We evaluate 28 general-purpose, science-oriented, chemistry-specialized, and embodied MLLMs in an offline, single-turn setting. Results show that current models can follow coarse experimental procedures in videos, but still struggle to ground actions into operable regions and feasible trajectories, to recognize fine-grained laboratory apparatus, states, and safety norms, and to order steps in mid-length procedures. BEAKER thus reveals a clear gap between coarse procedural understanding and the precise, action-grounded perception required for laboratory execution, providing a diagnostic benchmark for future MLLMs in SDCLs.

title: Where to Connect? Boosting MLLMs via Dynamic Gated Pathways across ALL ViT and LLM Layers
summary: A central yet under-explored question in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is where to connect---how visual information from a hierarchical vision encoder should be wired into the layer-wise semantics of a large language model. Mainstream MLLMs inject a fixed single-layer visual representation into the LLM and treat all LLM layers as a single consumer, ignoring that different layers demand different visual granularities. Recent multi-layer fusion methods either compress hierarchical features on the encoder side or rely on predefined sparse or hierarchical layer-to-layer connections, and therefore stop short of modeling adaptive cross-layer interactions between the ViT and LLM hierarchies. We address this gap with DGP (Dynamic Gated Pathways), a routing mechanism that establishes all-to-all connections between every ViT layer and every LLM layer, with each LLM layer dynamically gating its preference over visual layers conditioned on its own semantic state. Built on top of LLaVA-1.5-7B and 13B, DGP delivers consistent gains over the LLaVA-1.5-7B baseline (e.g., +4.2 on SQA$^{I}$, +3.3 on MM-Vet, +3.1 on VizWiz and LLaVA$^{W}$) and surpasses prior multi-layer visual fusion methods on most benchmarks. Layer-wise routing analyses further show that different LLM layers do select different visual granularities on demand, supporting both the effectiveness and interpretability of the proposed dynamic gated pathways. The code is available: https://github.com/YingyingYan1/DGP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种动态门控路径机制（DGP），通过在ViT与LLM各层之间建立全连接并按需动态选择视觉粒度，显著提升了多模态大语言模型的性能。

title: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning for Remote Sensing in Urban Management
summary: Fine-grained visual reasoning is essential for remote sensing in urban management, yet remains underexplored in the evaluation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We introduce UMBench, a fine-grained urban remote sensing benchmark built from unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) images for multiple urban management tasks such as traffic monitoring, urban construction, environmental quality, and disaster warning. Evaluations on UMBench reveal that current MLLMs often rely on scene-level priors and overlook fine-grained visual evidence. To address this issue, we further propose a novel evidence-first chain-of-thought method that directs models to inspect fine-grained visual evidence in a training-free manner. Experiments show that our method can improve the performance of both open-source and commercial MLLMs on UMBench.

title: DreamRealm: Exploring and Materializing Hallucination Worlds for Trustworthy Vision-Language Models
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain prone to visual hallucinations when correct responses depend on subtle visual details. One line of post-training methods constructs visual contrasts through image retrieval, generation, or editing to improve fine-grained perception. However, these contrasts are not built around the model's own hallucinations, making it difficult to ensure that supervision targets its actual perceptual confusions. Another line suppresses hallucinated outputs through response correction or preference learning under fixed image conditions, but leaves the design of supervision signals on the image-input side underexplored. Inspired by how humans correct misconceptions, we introduce DreamRealm, a post-training framework that explores diverse latent hallucinated responses, minimally edits original images to make them valid, and trains the model to assign each response to its supporting image. Our data construction pipeline, RealmForgePipe, mines observed and latent hallucinations from a target model and materializes them through image editing. Using hallucinations mined from Qwen3.5-9B, we construct the Realized Hallucination Dataset (RealmSet). Our training objective, RealmMatch, constructs a likelihood score matrix across image--response combinations and combines supervised learning with bidirectional contrastive losses to reinforce correct matches and suppress mismatches. Compared with the original Qwen3.5-9B model, DreamRealm improves performance across six visual perception and hallucination benchmarks, including gains of 7.26 percentage points in HallusionBench accuracy and 11.34 percentage points in MMVP pair accuracy. Together with ablation studies on data construction and training methods, these results demonstrate that hallucination assignment is a promising paradigm for improving visual perception and mitigating hallucinations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DreamRealm后训练框架，通过挖掘并图像化模型自身的潜在幻觉响应来训练模型进行正确的幻觉分配，从而有效缓解多模态大语言模型的视觉幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在处理细微视觉细节时易产生视觉幻觉，且现有的后训练方法未能有效针对模型自身的感知混淆进行监督，或忽略了图像输入端的监督信号设计。
AI.method: 提出DreamRealm框架及其数据构建流程RealmForgePipe，挖掘目标模型的潜在幻觉，通过最小化图像编辑使其合理化，并利用RealmMatch训练目标结合监督学习和双向对比损失，训练模型将幻觉响应匹配至其支持的真实图像。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-9B模型上应用该方法后，在六个视觉感知和幻觉基准测试中表现均显著提升，其中HallusionBench准确率提升7.26个百分点，MMVP配对准确率提升11.34个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 基于幻觉分配范式的DreamRealm框架能够有效改善模型的视觉感知能力并减轻视觉幻觉，相关消融实验也进一步验证了数据构建和训练方法的有效性。

title: Entropogram-guided Visual Realignment Decoding: Capturing the Rhythm of Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress on cross-modal reasoning tasks, yet they continue to suffer from hallucinations in long-chain reasoning processes. In this work, we revisit hallucination in MLLMs from the perspective of reasoning generation dynamics. We argue that entropy is not merely a static measure of uncertainty but a structured signal that reflects how modality information is integrated throughout decoding. Through systematic analysis, we identify two characteristic entropy patterns associated with hallucination behaviors: (1) a generally high-confidence regime corresponds to premature convergence to inappropriate multimodal interactions; and (2) local abrupt entropy transitions are associated with reasoning instability and hallucination onset. Building on these observations, we propose an entropy-aware self-introspective framework for MLLM reasoning. Our method continuously tracks entropy dynamics during decoding and performs targeted visual re-alignment when suspicious hallucination states are detected, encouraging the model to re-examine salient visual evidence at critical reasoning stages. Extensive experiments across six multimodal reasoning benchmarks spanning nine distinct evaluation settings demonstrate that our approach delivers robust improvements in reasoning accuracy and hallucination robustness, while providing new insights into the generation dynamics underlying MLLM failures. The code is available at: https://github.com/jden4524/SelfRetrospectiveDecoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种熵感知自省框架，通过跟踪解码过程中的熵动态来检测多模态大语言模型的幻觉状态，并执行视觉重新对齐以提升推理的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在跨模态推理任务中取得了显著进展，但在长链推理过程中仍易产生幻觉。本文旨在从推理生成动态的角度重新审视并解决这一问题。
AI.method: 通过分析两种与幻觉相关的熵模式（高置信度导致过早收敛、局部熵突变导致推理不稳定），提出一种熵感知自省框架，在检测到可疑幻觉状态时进行有针对性的视觉重新对齐，促使模型重新审查关键视觉证据。
AI.result: 在六个多模态推理基准和九种评估设置上的实验表明，该方法在推理准确性和抗幻觉鲁棒性方面取得了显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效提升了MLLMs推理的准确性和鲁棒性，并为理解模型生成失败背后的动态机制提供了新视角。

title: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Personalized Reasoning of Vision-Language Models
summary: People often make decisions by holistically reasoning over heterogeneous forms of personal information. In this paper, we study the relatively underexplored capability of multimodal personalized reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). To this end, we introduce \texttt{MPRBench}, a novel and comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate personalized reasoning across a wide range of tasks and real-world challenges. \texttt{MPRBench} consists of 12 sub-tasks and additionally supports interpretable analysis of representative error cases. Through extensive experiments, we find that current personalized MLLMs still struggle with personalized reasoning due to several key challenges, including inaccurate recognition of personalized concepts and sensitivity to irrelevant personal information. We hope that MPRBench will stimulate further research on personalized reasoning in MLLMs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/kkdh15/MPRBench

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为MPRBench的新型综合基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在个性化推理方面的能力。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在多模态个性化推理能力上研究不足的问题，因为现实决策常需整合异构的个人信息。
AI.method: 提出了MPRBench基准，该基准包含12个子任务，支持对代表性错误案例进行可解释分析，以评估广泛任务和现实挑战中的个性化推理。
AI.result: 实验发现，当前的个性化MLLMs在个性化推理上仍存在困难，主要原因包括对个性化概念识别不准确以及对无关个人信息过于敏感。
AI.conclusion: MPRBench有望促进对MLLMs中个性化推理的进一步研究。

title: CARE-FL: Federated Fine-Tuning of Multimodal LLMs in Resource-Constrained Edge Networks
summary: Domain-specific adaptation of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in privacy-sensitive edge environments requires federated fine-tuning, yet client selection remains challenging due to heterogeneous multimodal data and modality availability, dynamic system conditions, and evolving client utility during training. We propose Constraint-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Federated Fine-Tuning (CARE-FL), a constrained online client-selection framework for federated MLLM Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning. CARE-FL formulates client participation as a sequential decision process and employs Q-value decomposition to address the large combinatorial joint action space through scalable client-level long-term utility estimation. These utilities are learned online using a modified Double Deep Q-Learning (DDQL) scheme, while constraint-aware $ε$-greedy execution selects feasible client subsets under per-round latency and bandwidth constraints. Complementing client selection, an adaptive aggregation mechanism further controls potentially unstable global updates and places greater weight on the previous model when needed. Experiments on the CrisisMMD disaster-response task in emulated heterogeneous wireless edge environments show that CARE-FL achieves higher and more stable test accuracy than the compared client-selection baselines across different system settings, while satisfying the imposed latency and bandwidth constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为CARE-FL的约束感知强化学习框架，用于在边缘环境中高效、稳定地进行多模态大语言模型的联邦微调。
AI.motivation: 在隐私敏感的边缘环境中进行多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的联邦微调时，由于多模态数据和模态可用性的异构性、动态的系统条件以及训练中不断演化的客户端效用，导致客户端选择面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: CARE-FL将客户端参与建模为序列决策过程，利用Q值分解解决组合动作空间爆炸问题；通过改进的Double Deep Q-Learning (DDQL)在线学习客户端长期效用，并结合约束感知的ε-贪婪策略在延迟和带宽约束下选择客户端；此外，引入自适应聚合机制以稳定全局更新。
AI.result: 在模拟的异构无线边缘环境中的CrisisMMD灾害响应任务上，CARE-FL在不同系统设置下均比其他客户端选择基线获得了更高且更稳定的测试准确率，并满足了延迟和带宽约束。
AI.conclusion: CARE-FL框架能够有效解决边缘环境中联邦MLLM微调的客户端选择难题，在满足系统资源约束的同时，显著提升了模型性能与训练稳定性。

title: DSRS: Teaching MLLMs to Perceive, Reason, and Segment in Complex Driving Scenes
summary: Existing reasoning segmentation frameworks typically employ multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with broad world knowledge to extract semantics in a human-like manner and generate corresponding segmentation masks. Nevertheless, these frameworks lack the necessary scene-specific awareness. This paper introduces driving scene reasoning segmentation (DSRS), a scene-specific task that requires models to interpret implicit instructions, infer spatial relations, detect potential risks, handle challenging conditions, and comprehend underlying traffic rules, ultimately generating accurate segmentation masks. Meanwhile, we establish a benchmark dataset to facilitate future research on the DSRS task. To pioneer this task, we propose DSRS-Net, a novel architecture with advanced reasoning segmentation capability for automated driving. Specifically, DSRS-Net seamlessly infuses geometric features for deeper reasoning segmentation, without compromising the original multimodal fusion mechanism. This strategy effectively mitigates the modality representation mismatch in MLLMs caused by RGB-only pretraining, while enhancing the integration of geometric, contextual, and linguistic features. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of DSRS-Net in both driving scene reasoning segmentation and other language-driven segmentation tasks across various public datasets. The source code and dataset will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了驾驶场景推理分割（DSRS）任务及基准数据集，并设计了融合几何特征的新架构DSRS-Net以提升自动驾驶中的推理分割能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于多模态大语言模型的推理分割框架缺乏驾驶场景所需的场景特定感知能力，难以有效处理隐式指令、空间关系、潜在风险及交通规则。
AI.method: 提出DSRS-Net架构，在多模态融合机制中无缝注入几何特征，以缓解仅RGB预训练导致的模态表示不匹配，并增强几何、上下文和语言特征的整合。
AI.result: 在多个公共数据集上的实验表明，DSRS-Net在驾驶场景推理分割及其他语言驱动分割任务中均取得了卓越的性能。
AI.conclusion: DSRS-Net有效填补了驾驶场景特定推理分割的空白，相关源代码和数据集将在发表后开源以促进未来研究。

title: Beyond Risk Cues: A Mechanism-Level Benchmark and Verifiable Debate for Scam Video Detection on the Web
summary: Online scam videos pose significant threats to individuals and society. Existing studies primarily focus on binary classification, offering limited insights into how scams work and the reasoning behind detection decisions. Moreover, they often overlook the challenge of distinguishing scam videos from superficially similar non-scam content, such as advertisements, and the robustness of detection models against misleading arguments. These limitations hinder reliable scam video detection. To address these limitations, we introduce MechScam, a benchmark comprising 6,614 videos covering diverse scam mechanisms and non-scam categories. MechScam provides explanations supported by video evidence, annotations of potential scam elements and their context, and misleading arguments constructed from genuine evidence. Recognizing that genuine evidence can still be used to justify misleading conclusions, we further propose ScamCourt, a debate framework in which trained prosecution and defense debaters present opposing arguments, while a trained judge makes decisions based on a transcript with verified citations. Extensive experiments show that state-of-the-art MLLMs struggle to distinguish scam videos from similar non-scam content. ScamCourt outperforms larger MLLMs and same-backbone fine-tuned baselines, reducing false positives and showing stronger resistance to misleading arguments. Together, MechScam and ScamCourt contribute to more reliable and interpretable scam video detection. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/SuperYFan/MechScam.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MechScam基准和ScamCourt辩论框架，以解决现有诈骗视频检测在机制理解、区分相似非诈骗内容及抵抗误导性论据方面的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有在线诈骗视频检测研究多局限于二分类，缺乏对诈骗机制和检测决策推理的理解，难以区分诈骗视频与表面相似的非诈骗内容（如广告），且模型对误导性论据的鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 提出包含6,614个视频的MechScam基准，提供视频证据支持的解释、诈骗元素标注及其上下文，以及由真实证据构建的误导性论据；同时提出ScamCourt辩论框架，由训练后的控辩双方提出对立论据，并由训练后的法官基于带有经验证的转录文本做出决策。
AI.result: 最先进的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）难以区分诈骗视频与相似非诈骗内容；ScamCourt优于更大的MLLMs和同骨干微调基线模型，减少了误报，并对误导性论据表现出更强抵抗力。
AI.conclusion: MechScam和ScamCourt共同促进了更可靠且可解释的诈骗视频检测，为未来优化检测模型的机制理解和抗干扰能力提供了基础。

title: Robots in the City: Persona-Based Perceptions of Urban Robots
summary: Pedestrians increasingly encounter robots in urban public spaces without interacting with them, but how robots change the perceived safety of a street remains unclear. We examine how robot presence and type affect perceived safety across urban contexts. We generate 18 images of Seoul streets that vary in time of day, road class, and robot condition (no robot, a delivery robot, or a humanoid). Two multimodal large language models (MLLMs), Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma4-26B, each conditioned on 500 synthetic personas, choose the safer image in each pair, and 25 human respondents complete the same task. Both models prefer streets without robots and favor the delivery robot over the humanoid. Robots are chosen more often at night and less often by older personas, whereas road class has smaller effects. In the model rationales, the delivery robot appears as a physical obstacle, whereas the humanoid appears as either a threat or a source of protection. Like humans, both models chose robots more often at night, but chose the humanoid over the delivery robot far less often, and Gemma showed a night effect for the humanoid about three times that of humans. These results show that the effect of a robot on perceived safety depends on when it appears, and that persona-conditioned MLLMs capture only part of human judgments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机器人在城市街道中对行人感知安全的影响，并评估多模态大语言模型在模拟人类判断方面的表现。
AI.motivation: 随着机器人在城市空间中出现，其对街道感知安全的影响尚不明确，因此需要研究机器人存在和类型在不同城市环境下如何改变行人的安全感。
AI.method: 生成18张首尔街道图像，控制时间、道路等级和机器人条件变量；使用两个基于合成人设的多模态大语言模型（Qwen3.8-27B和Gemma4-26B）以及25名人类受访者进行图像对的安全性选择任务。
AI.result: 模型和人类均偏好无机器人街道；配送机器人被视为物理障碍而更受青睐，人形机器人被视为威胁或保护源；夜间机器人被选中的频率增加，但模型与人存在差异（如Gemma的夜间人形机器人效应约为人类的三倍）。
AI.conclusion: 机器人对感知安全的影响取决于其出现的时间，且基于人设条件化的多模态大语言模型仅能捕捉部分人类对机器人安全性的判断。
